_comment: Companions who leave town with the player and never come home (systems/vanishings.js). Each loss is scored for suspicion: the base for how they died, plus what makes it look like foul play. The tier picks the memory kind (data/npcMemory.json) their kin and town keep, the regard lost, the talk and the wariness of the next who are asked to join.

howWords.old_age: died of old age on the road

doubt.title: Questions in {town}
doubt.text: {name} left {town} with you and will not come home. Their family will want to know what happened.

foul.title: Whispers in {town}
foul.text: {name} left {town} with you and will not come home. Folk there already wonder whether it was the road that killed them.

told.title: Word brought to {town}
told.text: You tell {name}'s family how it happened: {name} {how}.

noWord.title: No word in {town}
noWord.text: {name}'s family in {town} have waited for word of them, and none has come from you.

refuseJoin: Go with you? My {vr} {vn} went with you, and never came home.

persona.lost: Your {vr} {vn} left with {player} on the road {when} and never came home: {vn} {how}.
persona.lostNoHow: Your {vr} {vn} left with {player} on the road {when} and never came home. You do not know what became of them.
persona.told: {player} came and told your family how it happened.
persona.untold: {player} has never come to tell your family what happened.
persona.grief: You grieve; you would want to hear of their last days.
persona.doubt: You wonder what {player} is not telling. You are wary of them.
persona.foul: You suspect {player} had a hand in it. You are cold and guarded with them, and it may come out.
persona.town: Folk in your town whisper that {vn}, who left with {player}, met with foul play.
persona.townDoubt: Folk in your town remember that {vn} left with {player} and never came back.
